verdict.rationale: Angular ships an extensive documented public API (components, DI, signals, router, etc.) as expected for any framework, and angular.dev now exposes an llms.txt plus 'AI-forward resources and integrations' aimed at AI tooling. However there is no evidence of a distinct agent-facing control surface (e.g., a CLI/automation API meant for AI agents to drive builds, code generation, or app behavior) beyond the standard developer API. Missing for 10: concrete documentation of an AI-agent-specific interface or automation API, independent corroboration that AI tools actually consume the llms.txt/API successfully.
